objective: Separar la frontera determinista y cognitiva de B5-I1 en Topic Belonging, preservar la entrada humana ampliada y ejecutar únicamente cognición sintética.
preconditions: The active editorial profile is approved and activated.
Only synthetic cognitive boundary execution is used.
B5-I2 and later phases remain unauthorized.
canonical_inputs: Existing TopicBelongingInput contract with optional compatible intake extensions
Existing Topic Belonging workflow, storage, routing, and tests
non_objectives: B5-I2, B5-I3, B5.5, B6, B7, P2 REAL, S5 REAL, or product use
New runtime, provider, registry, gate, lifecycle, provenance system, or state system
Retrospective rewriting or reclassification of persisted episodes
New implementation outside the approved M1 scope
expected_outputs: Software preserves human and canonical fields in an immutable base.
Synthetic IA output is limited to TopicBelongingCognitiveProposal.
Field ownership is explicit: user-bound fields are USER_PROVIDED and cognitive fields are AI_PROPOSED.
Software combines and validates the existing TopicBelongingInput contract.
TOPIC_FIRST remains valid without narrative work.
ANCHOR_WORK_FIRST and CORPUS_FIRST may receive an AI-proposed topic while TOPIC_FIRST protects the user topic.
User instructions, duration, and target language propagate unchanged through the handoff into TopicBelongingInput.
Persisted historical TopicBelongingInput episodes remain readable and unchanged.
deterministic_validations: Mission contract, authorization, live state, and scope checks pass.
Topic Belonging focused synthetic tests pass.
A proposed central question is accepted only when the user supplied none, and its ownership is recorded as AI_PROPOSED.
AI-proposed evidence remains explicitly AI_PROPOSED and is not promoted to system-verified evidence.
Protected human and canonical fields reject conflicting cognitive output.
Instructions preserve category and exact text; duration and language remain user-owned deterministic fields.
Historical compatibility and TOPIC_FIRST behavior are tested.
adversarial_cases: Cognitive output attempts to overwrite topic, question, mode, profile, or references.
Cognitive output attempts to propose a topic in TOPIC_FIRST or omits a required topic proposal in another mode.
Cognitive output contains deterministic metadata or final-contract-only fields.
Existing persisted final input is loaded without a retrospective proposal.
stop_conditions: Any real provider, local model, or external cognitive call.
Any file or phase outside this scope is required.
